earnings.title: STRYKER REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 OPERATING RESULTS
highlights: Reported net sales increased 7.7% to $6.5 billion
Adjusted operating income margin (1) increased 60 bps to 26.2%

quotes.text: We delivered 7.7% organic sales growth and double-digit adjusted earnings growth in the quarter.

outlook: We are updating our full year 2026 guidance and now expect organic net sales growth (2) in the range of 6.5% to 7.0% and adjusted net earnings per diluted share (2) to be in the range of $14.80 to $14.90.
